text:
Ravi: spotted sporadic OOMs in embed-prod tail. Built hotfix image embed:fix-cache-2026-03-23-a1b2. Requesting expedited approval to run a 12m fast window and bypass full canary.

DeployBot: [deploy-request] image=redwood/embed:fix-cache-2026-03-23-a1b2 by Ravi
Needs: ops-approval, service-owner-approval, smoke-checks
Link: https://deploy/redwood/embed/requests/7061234000

Nina: how user-impacting?

Ravi: ~0.5% of encodes hit the broken path under concurrency spikes. Tail OOMs, no data loss.

SREOncall: I can own rollback. Criteria: OOM rate >0.25% in window OR sustained p95 latency +200ms.

Clara: as service owner I need to validate image sha and CI link.

Ravi: sha=a1b2, CI green: https://ci/embed/a1b2. Patch caps cache entries and adds defensive checks.

Ravi: smoke steps:
```
# quick smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://embed.prod/api/v1/encode -d '{"text":"smoke"}' | jq '.status'
# check recent OOMs
kubectl logs -n prod -l app=embed --since=5m | grep -i oom || true
```

DeployBot: Canary bypass requested. Policy: requires 2 human approvals. Current: 0/2.

SREOncall: +1 from me. I'll monitor dashboards and be ready to flip traffic.

Clara: +1 if Oncall owns rollback and EU is validated separately. Blocking global swap for EU until metrics look good.

Nina: scheduling fast window at 01:20 UTC: 5m ramp to 5%, 5m at 20%, 2m observation. Post runbook and release note.

Ravi: release note: "embed: cap cache entries to avoid tail OOMs; backported to 1.2.x; image fix-cache-2026-03-23-a1b2." Runbook: watch embed.oom_count, encode_error_rate, p95 latency; rollback to redwood/embed:1.2.9 on breach.

DeployBot: Approvals: SREOncall, Clara. Canary bypass granted. Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-23T01:20:00Z -> 01:32:00Z. Exec: https://deploy/redwood/embed/7061234000/exec

Ravi: starting now. Nina run smoke.

Nina: smoke OK, logs clean.

SREOncall: 5% ramp in. metrics look stable.

SREOncall: 20% ramp now. 5m check: p95 +8ms, error delta +0.04%, OOMs 0.

Clara: holding EU off until morning as planned. Global rollout deferred to normal cadence. Thanks team.

DeployBot: Deploy complete. Status: SUCCESS. Request closed by Ravi.

Ravi: closing thread — thanks for quick approvals. Will open follow-up if any regressions show. :white_check_mark:
